title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: confessions_post unchanged — still uses old inline OSCORE pattern
description: In coap_dtn.c:238-314, confessions_post() was NOT refactored to use coap_oscore_auth_mutating(). It still replicates the old inline OSCORE unprotect/peer_eui64/ifdef pattern that the commit claims to have extracted into the shared helper. This is a consistency and maintainability issue — deaddrop_post and msg_inbox_post were updated but confessions_post was left behind. Fix: convert confessions_post to use coap_oscore_auth_mutating() like the other two mutating resources.
